answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops fake identities. Each identity posts a 60-credit escrow, locked 20 epochs, and names its sponsor, like garden plots with visible neighbors. Any peer can raise a dispute signal on a cluster; if confirmed fake, its escrow is slashed and the sponsor loses half its own. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits. One honest agent pays 60 once and, at the zenith of verified work, earns undiluted rewards.
